acceptanceCriteria: Ruby and JS provider receipts carry caller-asserted requirement IDs per selected example, marked caller-asserted and never inferred, with tests.
body: Residual from V1-2039/V1-2040 (PR #1317, TSA-V0-410..419). V1-2040's AC says the receipt echoes each ID beside the example outcome; the lane echoes them only in `corvint-example-join/0` to avoid conflicting with #1311 and V1-2045. Expected: provider receipts carry a caller-asserted requirements field. Follow-up once #1311 and V1-2045 land.
title: Ruby and JS provider receipts cannot carry caller-asserted requirement IDs directly
